post.description:
Ask the assistant for the next turn of the AI answer and wait for it.

Synchronous: the request holds until the turn is validated and stored, or has failed
(nothing is stored then). The turn is a clarifying `question` or the `advice`; at most two
questions are asked, and none after a `skip` reply or in an urgent turn.

While a question is open, `reply` is required (409 `reply_required`); without one it is
refused (409 `no_open_question`). The reply is stored first and stays if the turn then
fails, so "Try again" posts `{locale}` only. One turn at a time per incident (409
`turn_in_progress`); the advice closes the AI answer (409 `advice_exists`). Failures: 502
`provider_error` or `invalid_output`, 504 `timeout`. In demo mode the answer is replayed
from a recording; with none for this case, 503 `no_recording`: no turn is stored (a reply
sent with it stays, as on any failure), and trying again gives the same answer.

get.description: The incident's damage report; 404 when the incident or the report doesn't exist.

patch.description: Edit the body, or mark it `sent` (or back to `draft`).

post.description:
Draft the damage report with the assistant and wait for it (ADR 0009).

Only for a pothole incident (422 `not_pothole_damage`); a later type change keeps it. One
per incident (409 `damage_report_exists`) unless `replace: true`, which overwrites it,
sets it back to `draft` and answers 200. It runs under the incident's turn lock (409
`turn_in_progress`) and fails like an AI turn (502 `provider_error` / `invalid_output`,
504 `timeout`, 503 `no_recording` in demo mode), storing nothing.

Look up real places around the incident's location and store them as its snapshot.

Replaces the snapshot only on success: 503 `nearby_unavailable` keeps the previous one.
409 `no_location` when the incident has none. In demo mode the places recorded for the
scenario at that radius; 503 `nearby_not_recorded` when there are none.

Add one photo: a multipart `file`, or `{sample_id}` for a bundled sample photo.

The server re-encodes every file (EXIF orientation applied, long edge at most 2048 px,
no metadata). 409 `photo_limit` past five, 413 `photo_too_large`, 415
`unsupported_media_type` for anything but a decodable JPEG, PNG or WebP, 403
`demo_uploads_disabled` for a file in demo mode, 422 `unknown_sample`.
